statements.subject: message
statements.description: All JSON serializations of the A2A protocol data model MUST use camelCase naming for field names, not the snake_case convention used in Protocol Buffer definitions.

statements.subject: context
statements.description: Protocol Buffer field: context_id → JSON field: contextId. All JSON serializations MUST use camelCase naming.

statements.subject: agent_card
statements.description: Protocol Buffer field: default_input_modes → JSON field: defaultInputModes. All JSON serializations MUST use camelCase naming.

statements.subject: push_notification
statements.description: Protocol Buffer field: push_notification_config → JSON field: pushNotificationConfig. All JSON serializations MUST use camelCase naming.

statements.subject: task
statements.description: Enum values MUST be represented according to the ProtoJSON specification, which serializes enums as their string names as defined in the Protocol Buffer definition (typically SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE). Protocol Buffer enum: TASK_STATE_INPUT_REQUIRED → JSON value: "TASK_STATE_INPUT_REQUIRED"
